newsitem.title: USA: NHL to review expansion team proposals next week.
newsitem.headline: NHL to review expansion team proposals next week.

text.p: National Hockey League's Executive Committee will reconvene Feb 18 to review proposals from cities seeking an expansion team, but an NHL spokesman Monday emphasized that no decision is in the offing.

"There has been no timetable set for (a decision), there has been nothing like that," Andy McGowan, the NHL's director of public relations, said. "This is just to get to back together and review the applications that were made, and the presentations that were made."
Eleven presentations from nine cities were made to the League on Jan 13 and 14 in New York, McGowan said.

Three proposals came from Houston, Texas, and one each from Atlanta, Ga.; Oklahoma City, Okla., Nashville, Tenn.; the Hampton Roads, Va., area; the Raleigh-Durham, N.C., area; Hamilton, Ontario; Columbus, Ohio; and the Minneapolis-St. Paul, Minn., area.
